ForgeDesc:
TapPressClick to open a Basic Weapon Box and select one of four basic weapons to obtain it.
This item will disappear after use.

TapPressClick to open an Ascension Weapon Box and select one of four ascension weapons to obtain it.
This item will disappear after use.

TapPressClick to open the Privilege Weapon Box and select one of four privileged equipment to obtain it.
This item will disappear after use.

TapPressClick to recruit a character. Select one from four **1-cost characters** to obtain them.
This item will disappear after use.

TapPressClick to recruit a character. Select one from four <color=cce9f>2-cost characters** to obtain them.
This item will disappear after use.

TapPressClick to recruit a character. Select one from four <color=ff>3-cost characters** to obtain them.
This item will disappear after use.

TapPressClick to recruit a character. Select one from four <color=fe7>4-cost characters** to obtain them.
This item will disappear after use.

TapPressClick to recruit a character. Select one from four **5-cost characters** to obtain them.
This item will disappear after use.

TapPressClick to open the Emblem Codex and select one of four emblems to obtain.
This item will disappear after use.

TapPressClick to open an Expert Invitation and select one reward from up to four "Expert Advisors" or "Gold Coins."
This item disappears after use.

TapPressClick to open an Aha Basic Weapon Box and select one of four pieces of Aha basic equipment to obtain.
This item will disappear after use.
